svg.aria-label: The states with a side label in the coordinates side label and remainder: a curved triangle whose lower edge is the image of the circle phi = 13/4, resting on r = 0 at the side state; it lies right of 9/25 and above the dashed parabola 9/5 (l - pi/6) squared
